The critical gap is MR-11, tied to monitoring metrics and thresholds, and the documentation status is major gaps in plain words because a critical monitoring section is absent.","citations":[{"doc_id":"nist_ai_rmf","locator":"MANAGE 4.1"},{"doc_id":"eu_ai_act","locator":"Article 72"}]}]},{"heading":"Checklist gaps","claims":[{"text":"MR-11 is missing: the documentation does not provide monitoring metrics and thresholds for ongoing use. This is the listed critical gap and is the gap identified for closure before validation can start.","citations":[{"doc_id":"nist_ai_rmf","locator":"MANAGE 4.1"},{"doc_id":"eu_ai_act","locator":"Article 72"}]},{"text":"MR-12 is missing: the documentation does not provide change management and incident-handling content. This absence relates to provisions on managing changes, responding to incidents, and serious incident reporting.","citations":[{"doc_id":"nist_ai_rmf","locator":"MANAGE 2.3"},{"doc_id":"nist_ai_rmf","locator":"MANAGE 4.3"},{"doc_id":"eu_ai_act","locator":"Article 73"}]}]},{"heading":"Section assessments","claims":[{"text":"No weak present sections were reported; the present sections cover what the checklist expects based on the cited documentation, including intended use, performance testing, data lineage, and privacy controls. The documentation states the fraud-risk scoring purpose, reports out-of-time testing, identifies data sources and reconciliation, and describes replacement of customer identifiers with random keys.","citations":[{"doc_id":"mdl-02-development_report","locator":"line 6"},{"doc_id":"mdl-02-development_report","locator":"line 24"},{"doc_id":"mdl-02-data_description","locator":"line 6"},{"doc_id":"mdl-02-data_description","locator":"line 20"}]}]},{"heading":"Matters for the validator","claims":[{"text":"The validator should ask the model owner to close MR-11 before validation can start by providing the missing monitoring package, including operational metrics, thresholds, review cadence, escalation triggers, and evidence of how monitoring will be performed after deployment. The provisions behind this critical gap are NIST AI RMF MANAGE 4.1 and EU AI Act Article 72.","citations":[{"doc_id":"nist_ai_rmf","locator":"MANAGE 4.1"},{"doc_id":"eu_ai_act","locator":"Article 72"}]},{"text":"The validator should also ask for the MR-12 change management and incident materials, including how model changes are approved, logged, tested, and rolled back, and how incidents are detected, escalated, recorded, and reported. This would address the documented gap against the change and incident-management provisions.","citations":[{"doc_id":"nist_ai_rmf","locator":"MANAGE 2.3"},{"doc_id":"nist_ai_rmf","locator":"MANAGE 4.3"},{"doc_id":"eu_ai_act","locator":"Article 73"}]}]}]}
